यौगक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the religious practice, &c. called
Yoga.
 E. योग, ठञ् aff.

यौगिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
 1. Customary, usual, common.
 2. Relating to
the Yoga, &c.
 3. Proper, regular, (as the sense of words, depen-
ing upon their derivation or construction.)
 E. योग and ठञ् aff.
